name: RetroStudio Lua Extensions
description: Lua extension library for RetroStudio game development

categories.name: Sprite
categories.description: Sprite creation, animation, and transform functions

functions.name: Create
functions.description: Create a sprite instance by asset name (loads .d2s/.d2f from build)

functions.name: Destroy
functions.description: Remove a sprite from the scene

functions.name: Clone
functions.description: Deep-clone a sprite instance and return a new handle

functions.name: SetXY
functions.description: Set sprite X and Y position

functions.name: GetXY
functions.description: Get sprite X and Y position

functions.name: SetPaletteSlot
functions.description: Set which palette slot this sprite uses

functions.name: SetAttributes
functions.description: Set sprite attribute flags (mirror, repeat, etc.)

functions.name: SetAnimation
functions.description: Set the active animation by name (does not auto-play)

functions.name: Play
functions.description: Start native auto-animation (ticked by engine, no Lua calls needed per frame)

parameters.name: animName
parameters.description: Animation name (optional, uses current if omitted)

functions.name: Stop
functions.description: Stop native auto-animation (freeze on current frame)

functions.name: UpdateAnimation
functions.description: Manual animation tick (for frame-level control from Lua)

functions.name: Create

functions.name: SetFrame

functions.name: GetFrameCount

functions.name: GetText

functions.name: GetXY

functions.name: SetPaletteSlot

functions.name: Create
functions.description: Create a music handle from a preloaded music asset name

functions.name: Destroy

functions.name: List

functions.description: Returns a bit array of keys currently held

functions.name: GetKeysReleased

functions.description: Returns true if the key is held

functions.name: Max
functions.description: Returns the maximum of two values

functions.description: Clamps x to min and max inclusive

parameters.name: x

functions.name: Random

functions.name: HoursToDegrees
functions.description: Returns the angle corresponding to the current time for positioning the hour hand. By default it uses minutes, seconds, and milliseconds for smooth movement.

parameters.name: smooth
parameters.description: When true or omitted, include smaller time units for smooth motion. When false, use stepped movement.

returns.description: Angle in degrees for the hour hand

functions.name: MinutesToDegrees
functions.description: Returns the angle corresponding to the current time for positioning the minute hand. By default it uses seconds and milliseconds for smooth movement.

parameters.name: smooth
parameters.description: When true or omitted, include smaller time units for smooth motion. When false, use stepped movement.

returns.description: Angle in degrees for the minute hand

functions.name: SecondsToDegrees
functions.description: Returns the angle corresponding to the current time for positioning the second hand. By default it uses milliseconds for smooth sweeping.

parameters.name: smooth
parameters.description: When true or omitted, include milliseconds for smooth motion. When false, use stepped movement.

returns.description: Angle in degrees for the second hand

functions.name: Day
functions.description: Returns the day of the month

functions.name: DayOfWeek
functions.description: Gets the string representation of the day of the week

functions.name: ToString
functions.description: Format time using standard C time library format string

functions.name: LogLua
functions.description: Log a message to the console from Lua

functions.name: SetClearColor
functions.description: Set the emulator clear color using a 24-bit RGB integer

functions.name: GetChargeState
functions.description: Returns the current battery and charger state as a table with power, voltage, percentage, and charger status fields.

returns.description: Table fields: plugged_in (boolean), battery_voltage_mv (int32), charger_state (string: off|precharge|normal_charge|finishing_charge), battery_percent (int32), charger_main_fsm (string), charger_main_fsm_raw (int32), charger_jeita_region (string), charger_die_temp_limit_exceeded (boolean), charger_ok_irq_status (int32), charger_nok_irq_status (int32)

functions.example:
local state = Battery.GetChargeState()
print(string.format('%d%% %dmV', state.battery_percent, state.battery_voltage_mv))
if state.charger_state ~= 'off' then
  print('charger: ' .. state.charger_state)
end
